ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)

must_have_properties: PCD shall transmit at 13.56 MHz ± 517 ppm with field strength 1.5 ≤ H ≤ 7.5 A/m within the operating volume.
PCD shall use 100% ASK Modified Miller for Type A PCD→PICC coding at 106 kbps.
PCD shall use 10% ASK NRZ-L for Type B PCD→PICC coding.
PICC shall load-modulate the 847.5 kHz subcarrier with Manchester (Type A) or BPSK (Type B) for PICC→PCD.
Every Type A standard frame shall protect each byte with one odd-parity bit and the whole frame with CRC_A (poly 0x8408 reflected, init 0x6363).
PICC shall answer REQA / WUPA with ATQA within fdt_listen ≤ 86.43 μs at 106 kbps.
PCD anti-collision loop shall be bit-frame at Cascade Level 1/2/3 with SEL = 0x93 / 0x95 / 0x97.
Cascade Tag 0x88 shall appear in UID-CLn[0] of every non-final Cascade Level.
BCC at each Cascade Level shall be UID-CLn[0] XOR UID-CLn[1] XOR UID-CLn[2] XOR UID-CLn[3].
Final SELECT (NVB = 0x70) shall be followed by a 1-byte SAK + 2-byte CRC_A.
SAK b3 = 1 shall indicate UID-CLn[0] was the Cascade Tag — PCD shall continue to next CL.
SAK b6 = 1 shall indicate ISO 14443-4 compliance — PCD may activate Layer 4 via RATS.
PICC shall transition to HALT on receipt of HLTA (0x50 0x00 + CRC_A); subsequent REQA shall not wake it (WUPA required).
Layer 4 RATS (0xE0) shall be followed by ATS reply with TL + T0 + optional TA(1)/TB(1)/TC(1) + historical bytes.
Layer 4 FWT shall obey FWT = (256 × 16 / fc) × 2^FWI; PICC shall respond within FWT or transmit S(WTX).
T=CL block format shall use PCB (0b00, 0b10, 0b11 in top 2 bits) + CID (optional) + NAD (optional) + INF + CRC_A.
T=CL block number shall alternate 0/1 per direction per successful exchange.

GetVersion shall be supported on MIFARE Ultralight EV1 / Plus EV1/EV2 / DESFire EV2/EV3 / DESFire Light, and its 7-byte response byte 2 shall deterministically identify the family per AN10833 Table 2.
must_not_have_properties: PCD shall not transmit RATS to a PICC whose SAK b6 = 0.
PICC shall not respond to REQA while in HALT (only WUPA wakes it).
PICC shall not respond with malformed CRC_A / CRC_B — frame is silently dropped.
PICC shall not respond if Type A byte parity is incorrect — frame is silently dropped.
Two PICCs in field shall not transmit simultaneously on the same subcarrier slot once anti-collision has converged.
PCD shall not exceed PICC's FSCI-advertised frame size on Layer 4.
PCD shall not declare communication failure before FWT (or extended FWT via WTX) has elapsed.
PICC shall not transition out of T_CL_ACTIVE state unless via S(DESELECT) or carrier removal.
Application above Layer 3 shall not be invoked on a PICC that has not completed SELECT cascade.

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Incorrect odd parity bit per byte; PICC silently ignores frame; PCD detects via timeout.
PICC silently ignores; PCD retries (typically up to 3 times).
PCD detects via direct XOR check; declares collision and restarts.
PCD detects collision bit position; bisects and restarts AC loop with extended NVB.
PICC silent on REQA; visible by no response; PCD uses WUPA next.
PCD or PICC observes mismatch; replies R(NAK); PCD retransmits.
PCD waits beyond FWT (or extended FWT via WTX); declares Layer 4 error.
Total state loss in PICC; PCD must restart at REQA.
PCD violation — PICC behavior undefined; may NAK, may stay silent, may ignore.
Legacy PICC returns command-not-supported or NAK; PCD falls back to ATQA/SAK identification.

fields.reset_behavior_compliance: On loss of carrier (envelope below POR threshold for > 1 ms typ), PICC enters POWER_OFF; all state lost. On re-entering field, PICC POR completes within ≤ 5 ms and PICC enters IDLE, fresh CID counter, T=CL block number = 0, UID/ATQA/SAK templates re-loaded from OTP.
fields.min_clock_constraint: PCD shall maintain unmodulated 13.56 MHz carrier whenever any PICC is expected to remain in field (carrier-driven clock for PICC); minimum continuous carrier presence between commands is implementation-defined but typically ≥ 1 ms (no gating).
fields.iso_10373_6_compliance_summary: Normative compliance tests against ISO 14443 are documented in ISO/IEC 10373-6, which prescribes: (a) PCD field strength at 6 reference positions in the calibration coil antenna, (b) PCD modulation envelope shape (pause duration, rise/fall), (c) PCD subcarrier sensitivity (minimum detectable load-modulation amplitude), (d) PCD bit-error rate at boundary positions, (e) anti-collision throughput across N PICCs, (f) FWT measurement and bound checks. AN10833 itself is non-normative — it documents the deterministic identification surface within the ISO 14443 normative envelope.
